newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Rome meeting to discuss treaty simplification.
newsitem.headline: Rome meeting to discuss treaty simplification.

text.p: The Dutch EU presidency has told its partners that it wants a decision on whether it is worth trying to simplify the EU treaty as part of the inter- governmental conference, an EU diplomat said on Monday.
It has set the special meeting of foreign ministers in Rome on March 25 as the time for a decision on whether it is worth continuing the effort.
A special General Affairs Council will meet in Italy as part of celebrations for the 40th anniversary of the Treaty of Rome.
During an IGC session on that day, the ministers will also discuss flexibility, the diplomat said.
